answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking correlated behavior through cryptographic evidence. If k identities equivocate on one consensus instance, the attributable penalty scales as O(k^2); detection additionally applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the coordinated swarm, with asymmetric depreciation of remaining stake. Thus a glacier-sized facade reaches its nadir quickly, and an orchard of aliases cannot cheaply reproduce honest influence.
